+<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"

+    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>
+

+            <roles>
+                <role>Maintainer</role>

+        </developer>

+            <id>ingenthron</id>

+            <organization>Couchbase, Inc.</organization>
+            <organizationUrl>http://couchbase.com</organizationUrl>
+            <roles>
+                <role>Developer</role>
+            </roles>
+        </developer>
+    </developers>
+    <contributors>
+        <contributor>
+            <name>Raghavan Srinivas</name>
+            <email>rags@couchbase.com</email>
+            <roles>
+                <role>Former Maintainer</role>
+            </roles>
+        </contributor>
+        <contributor>
+            <name>Deepti Dawar</name>
+            <email>deepti.dawar@globallogic.com</email>
